items.difficulty_reason: The lemma descends the at-worst-nodal relative-dimension-1 property from a limit morphism to a finite stage (statement lines 5096-5110). The proof (lines 5112-5138) is a complete three-step limit argument: syntomic descent, the relative-dimension decomposition with containment descent into the dimension-one piece, and unramifiedness descent for the Fitting-ideal singular locus. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: systematic application of the standard limit-descent lemmas in correct order.
